transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm only here because I don't know where else to go. There is a group of people—some kind of organization—that has been monitoring my every move and watching me constantly. I need someone to believe me and help make them stop.

Have there been times when you felt extremely high or energized, or very depressed, around the same time these experiences were happening? Or have the beliefs about being watched been present even when your mood felt normal?

No, I haven't experienced any extreme mood swings like that. My mood has felt pretty normal, and I don't feel depressed or overly energized. The only real issue is that these people are constantly monitoring me.

Aside from feeling watched, have you heard voices others can’t hear or had trouble organizing your thoughts or daily activities? Or is it mainly this one fixed belief while everything else feels normal?

No, I don't hear any voices, and I have absolutely no trouble organizing my thoughts or my daily tasks. My day-to-day life is completely normal and unaffected. The only issue is this very real and concerning situation of being constantly watched and monitored.
How long have you been feeling that this group is watching and monitoring you? Has this belief been present most days for at least a month?
It has been going on for much longer than just a month; it's been about a year and eight months of constant surveillance. Not a single day goes by where they aren't monitoring my every move.
Over this past year and eight months, has this affected your work, relationships, or ability to take care of yourself in a major way? Or have you otherwise been functioning pretty normally?

Aside from the stress of being monitored, I’ve been functioning pretty normally. I still go to work every day, pay my bills, and take care of my home without any issues. My daily routine and ability to look after myself haven't really been impaired.
